facts.text: Hopkinton was laid out in 1850 and officially incorporated in 1874, marking its early development in Iowa's history.
The former Lenox College campus now houses the Delaware County Historical Museum Complex, preserving the town’s Civil War era heritage.
Hopkinton celebrates its Civil War legacy each year with Civil War Days and draws enthusiasts to its Hot Rods & Harleys car show.
The town lies along the scenic Maquoketa River in southern Delaware County, offering picturesque river views for residents and visitors.
Lenox College, once a small institution in Hopkinton, closed its doors in 1944, leaving a historic campus behind.
Hopkinton’s public library hosts a variety of educational programs, fostering community learning and engagement throughout the year.
